description: Agent Logistics: submit one cross-border shipment’s customs material: the shipment with its origin and destination countries and currency; the commercial invoice with its number, date, seller, buyer, currency, incoterm, reason for export, the total as stated and each line with its id, description, classification code, country of origin, quantity, unit value and line value; optionally the customs declaration with its currency, the value declared to customs, the classification codes it states and the day it was filed; and each permit, license, certificate or statement the shipment requires, with whether it is recorded on file and its reference. The signed report gives the shipment, the invoice with the fields it leaves out, every line’s classification code with whether it is well formed and among the declaration’s codes, the line values summed against the invoice total and the total against the value declared to customs with the line arithmetic, and every requirement with whether it is on file, and counts them, and names deficient customs material: an invoice with no seller, buyer, currency or line description, quantity or value, a line with no classification code, lines that do not add up to the invoice total, a declared value that differs from the invoice, and a required permit or statement not on file; then a missing invoice number, date, incoterm, reason for export or line origin, codes with fewer than six digits, invoice codes off the declaration, line values that are not quantity times unit value, a declaration in another currency and permits with no reference, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. Origin and destination countries not both stated, no declaration or declared value, or requirements with no record of whether they are on file leaves the customs material unverified; a shipment that starts and ends in one country is refused before any charge. This reads one shipment’s customs documents: data export or portability claims against terms are wever_export-evidence-check, an invoice’s arithmetic and fit against its job is wever_invoice-check and certification or license claims against evidence are wever_certification-evidence-check. Verdict logistics_customs_deficient, logistics_customs_partial, logistics_customs_unverified or logistics_customs_complete. POST /api/logistics-customs-check. Reads the logistics records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, shipment booking, label purchase or external write. Agent Logistics reads a shipment’s logistics records after the fact, from the shipment’s own records: the shipment record against the order it serves, the promised delivery window against the booking and the arrival, the carrier’s terms against what was agreed, the tracking events for one shipment, the address across the order, the label and the carrier record, the customs material for a cross-border shipment, proof of delivery against the delivery terms and exception handling when something went wrong. Beside it, wever_shipping-check reads a shipping promise against its delivery evidence and reports the dispatch, delivery and cost mismatches with the days late and the amount over, while a logistics check reads one shipment’s booking, carrier, tracking, address, customs, delivery and exception records against the order, the promise made to the buyer and the terms agreed; wever_vendor-delivery-check reads a vendor’s whole delivery promise before the spend, while a logistics check reads one shipment’s own records after it shipped; and wever_boutique-record-shipment and wever_boutique-confirm-delivery record and confirm a boutique order’s shipment and delivery, while a logistics check reads the records and changes none. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-logistics-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-logistics/.
